Add banner component and pull-to-refresh for STAC pages (#221)

* Add banner component and pull-to-refresh for STAC pages.

Introduce aviary.banner and aviary.layout.refreshableScroll with page-level refresh control so HOME, feedback, language, and device management pages can reload app data sources on pull.

* Fix refresh action parsing and short-page pull gestures.

Read dataSourceId from action arguments, guard refresh controller after dispose, and make refreshable pages always scrollable without nesting scroll views.
